environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS with PostgreSQL RDS. The DB_USER 'audit_svc' has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the audit_logs table. Logs are shipped to CloudWatch via Fluent Bit with no sanitization. The application uses Logback with a JDBC appender configured to write structured log entries to a separate 'application_logs' table in the same database. An attacker can inject CRLF/newline characters into the 'action' or 'details' parameters which get interpolated into log messages, allowing forged log entries that appear as legitimate audit records in both the file-based logs and the database-backed log table.

config.db_privileges: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON audit_logs; INSERT ON application_logs
config.network: No WAF, direct ALB to pod routing
